questions.q: Which endorsement level can any user with write access to an item apply themselves, with no approval step?
options: Promoted
Certified
Master Data
Sensitivity labeled
questions.explain: Promoted is self-service — anyone with write/edit access to the item can apply it. Certified requires membership in an admin-authorized security group.

questions.q: Who is allowed to apply the Certified endorsement to an item?
options: Members of a security group a Fabric admin has specifically authorized to certify content
Any user who created the item
Every user in the tenant by default
Only the person who first viewed the item in the OneLake catalog
questions.explain: Certification is restricted to authorized security groups set up by a Fabric admin in the Certification tenant setting — it's never open to everyone by default.

questions.q: Where do you go to apply an endorsement level to a specific Fabric item?
options: The item's own Settings, under the Endorsement tab
The OneLake catalog's global search bar
The Power BI mobile app only
A separate standalone Endorsement app
questions.explain: Endorsement is applied from the item's own Settings, in its Endorsement tab, which offers None, Promoted, Certified, and (where enabled) Master Data.

questions.q: Where does the admin setting that controls who can certify content live?
options: OneLake catalog › Govern › Configurations › Tenant settings, under the Certification section
Inside each individual workspace's own local settings only
A user's personal account settings page
It cannot be configured — certification is always open to everyone
questions.explain: A Fabric admin enables certification and names the authorized security groups from the Govern hub's Tenant settings, under Certification.

questions.q: Why does endorsement matter for governance, beyond just looking nice in a list?
options: It steers self-service users toward already-vetted, reusable items instead of duplicating work with untrusted rebuilds
It automatically deletes any item that isn't endorsed
It replaces the need for row-level security entirely
It is required before an item can be shared with anyone at all
questions.explain: A visible Promoted or Certified badge, shown right in search results and the OneLake catalog, answers "which of these should I trust" before a user even opens the item — cutting down on duplicate, untrusted work.
